Population (in millions). Denominator for per-capita derivations.
Number of persons engaged (in millions). Labor input; not an unemployment rate.
Average annual hours worked by persons engaged. Total labor input = emp * avh.
Human capital index based on years of schooling and returns to education. It is not bounded to 0-1 or 0-10.

Real domestic absorption at chained PPPs; not capital depreciation.
Total factor productivity (TFP) level at current PPPs. PWT 10.01 productivity measure.
Capital stock at constant 2017 national prices, indexed to 2017=1; not a USD level.
